item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 04 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Esperanza, PioV.Corpuz, Placer, Cataingan), #Romblon(SanFernando, Magdiwang, Cajidiocan, Ferrol, Looc and Alcantara) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(SantaMaria, Odiongan, SanAgustin, SanAndres, Corcuera, Romblon and Calatrava) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
